summary: No existing paid membership listing qualified for reclassification based on generally available free membership. Clarified nine existing free listings and four account or membership listings.

verified_free_access.offering: EMU Caring: Safety in the Epilepsy Monitoring Unit
verified_free_access.account_or_membership: Free myAES account plus activity registration; paid AES membership is not required
verified_free_access.completion: Read disclosures, study modules, satisfactorily complete pre and post assessments and submit evaluation

verified_free_access.offering: EEG U, including Neonatal EEG on November 12, 2026
verified_free_access.account_or_membership: Free individual webinar registration and accurate ASET account details and ID; paid professional membership is not required
verified_free_access.availability: Registration open; Neonatal EEG live November 12, 2026 at noon Pacific / 3 PM Eastern
verified_free_access.completion: Select credit at registration; attend overwhelming majority live using individual Zoom link; allow 5 to 7 weeks for posting
restrictions: Elevate U does not award CEUs
verified_free_access.documentation_fee_note: ASET charges nonmembers $30 for an individually purchased transcript, separate from earning credit. Do not imply a Zoom email is necessarily sufficient for ABRET.

verified_free_access.account_or_membership: Free registration; no paid membership required
verified_free_access.availability: Each current lecture limited to first 300 viewers; remaining places not exposed; no calendar expiration published
verified_free_access.completion: Register, watch lecture and follow postlecture survey instructions
restrictions: Lectures marked closed no longer award ASET credit

paid_membership_checks.finding: Standard membership has dues. A free account/ASET ID for credit tracking is distinct from paid member benefits. Nonmember individual transcript costs $30.
Standard membership has dues. Complimentary emeritus membership is restricted and requires approval; it is not a general free enrollment route.
Webinar benefits are included with paid membership; nonmembers purchase access. No general free membership verified.
Free myAES account differs from paid professional membership. Restricted senior membership is not a general free enrollment route.

free_account_not_sufficient.finding: Free account and course access. Listed 1.5 contact hours are California BRN nursing credit, provider 16614. EEG technologist eligibility, ABRET acceptance, separate credit fees and expiration are unconfirmed. Retain Verify Cost and Credit.
An ASET ID does not require ASET membership, but that does not establish that the event and credit are free. Preserve Verify Cost and Credit pending explicit fee evidence.

future_scan_rule: Treat generally available free membership like free account registration only when both course access and applicable EEG technologist credit are independently verified at no charge. Check certificate/transcript charges separately; retain viewer caps, live-only rules and expiration.
